panel.note: Custom step inserted between surface.50 (counter) and surface.100; distinct chrome layer.

display.purpose: The one hero readout on a screen. Confirmed use: the POS running total only.

headline.purpose: Large stat callouts — audit outcome counts, summary totals.

title.purpose: Screen titles (1rem) and section/dialog titles (0.875rem), both semibold.

body.purpose: Default UI text, table cells, row/card titles at medium weight.

label.purpose: Field labels, table headers, nav captions, badges, kbd hints.

shadows.name: dropdown
shadows.purpose: Search-result / autocomplete popovers anchored to an input (shadow-lg shadow-ink/5).

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Default duration range for hover/focus/color transitions and progress-bar fills across the app.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion disables pulse skeletons, progress transforms, and color transitions app-wide.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled amber action per view — completes the task (e.g. Complete sale, New product).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-signal, oklch(72% 0.15 75)); color: var(--color-ink, oklch(24% 0.014 75)); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 0.375rem; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(66% 0.155 75); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-counter, oklch(98% 0.006 75)), 0 0 0 4px var(--color-signal, oklch(72% 0.15 75)); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-primary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action — transparent background, muted text (e.g. Retry, Clear filters).
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--color-muted, oklch(50% 0.014 75)); font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 0.375rem; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s ease-out, background 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--color-ink, oklch(24% 0.014 75)); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-line, oklch(90% 0.008 75)) 60%, transparent); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-counter, oklch(98% 0.006 75)), 0 0 0 4px var(--color-signal, oklch(72% 0.15 75)); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-ghost { transition: none; } }

components.name: Search / Scan Field
components.description: Signature input: leading search icon, placeholder invites scanning. Focus must always be predictable so scanned input lands here.
components.css: .ds-search { position: relative; } .ds-search-icon { position: absolute; left: 0.75rem; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); width: 1rem; height: 1rem; color: var(--color-muted, oklch(50% 0.014 75)); } .ds-search-input { width: 100%; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem 0.5rem 2.25rem; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--color-ink, oklch(24% 0.014 75)); background: var(--color-counter, oklch(98% 0.006 75)); border: 1px solid var(--color-field, oklch(62% 0.013 75)); border-radius: 0.375rem; } .ds-search-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-muted, oklch(50% 0.014 75)); } .ds-search-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-signal, oklch(72% 0.15 75)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-signal, oklch(72% 0.15 75)); }

components.name: Status Badge (tint)
components.description: Semantic outcome chip (audit result, movement status). Tinted background at 10%, never amber.
components.css: .ds-badge-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 0.375rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-badge-status--success { background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(53% 0.13 150) 10%, transparent); color: oklch(53% 0.13 150); } .ds-badge-status--danger { background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(52% 0.17 27) 10%, transparent); color: oklch(52% 0.17 27); } .ds-badge-status--info { background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(54% 0.13 264) 10%, transparent); color: oklch(54% 0.13 264); }

components.name: Neutral Badge (outline)
components.description: Role tags and 'coming soon' markers — outline, uppercase, wide tracking.
components.css: .ds-badge-neutral { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; padding: 0.125rem 0.375rem; border-radius: 0.25rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-line, oklch(90% 0.008 75)); color: var(--color-muted, oklch(50% 0.014 75)); }

components.name: Empty State Card
components.description: Reused across catalog, audits, and lists: icon circle, semibold title, muted explanation, single CTA.
components.html:
No products yet

Add your first product to start the catalog.
components.css: .ds-empty { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; text-align: center; padding: 3rem 1.5rem; border: 1px dashed var(--color-line, oklch(90% 0.008 75)); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--color-counter, oklch(98% 0.006 75)); } .ds-empty-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-panel, oklch(96.2% 0.007 75)); color: var(--color-muted, oklch(50% 0.014 75)); } .ds-empty-icon svg { width: 1.25rem; height: 1.25rem; } .ds-empty-title { margin-top: 0.75rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-ink, oklch(24% 0.014 75)); } .ds-empty-desc { max-width: 20rem; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--color-muted, oklch(50% 0.014 75)); }

components.name: Dialog / Sheet
components.description: Hand-rolled: mobile bottom sheet becoming a centered desktop dialog at sm (640px). Ink-tinted backdrop, never generic black.
components.html:
Choose a unit

Unit list goes here.
components.css: .ds-sheet-backdrop { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: center; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-ink, oklch(24% 0.014 75)) 40%, transparent); padding: 0; } .ds-sheet { width: 100%; max-height: 80vh; display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; background: var(--color-counter, oklch(98% 0.006 75)); border: 1px solid var(--color-line, oklch(90% 0.008 75)); border-radius: 0.75rem 0.75rem 0 0; box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px oklch(24% 0.014 75 / 0.1); } .ds-sheet-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line, oklch(90% 0.008 75)); } .ds-sheet-title { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-ink, oklch(24% 0.014 75)); } .ds-sheet-close { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 1.75rem; height: 1.75rem; border-radius: 0.375rem; border: none; background: transparent; color: var(--color-muted, oklch(50% 0.014 75)); cursor: pointer; } .ds-sheet-close:hover { color: var(--color-ink, oklch(24% 0.014 75)); } .ds-sheet-close svg { width: 0.75rem; height: 0.75rem; } .ds-sheet-body { padding: 1rem; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--color-muted, oklch(50% 0.014 75)); } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-sheet-backdrop { align-items: center; padding: 1rem; } .ds-sheet { max-width: 32rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; } }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar navigation link. Active item gets the Signal-colored icon + label; the only recurring non-action use of amber.
components.html: Products
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.625rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 0.375rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-muted, oklch(50% 0.014 75)); text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.15s ease-out, color 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-line, oklch(90% 0.008 75)) 60%, transparent); color: var(--color-ink, oklch(24% 0.014 75)); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-counter, oklch(98% 0.006 75)), 0 0 0 4px var(--color-signal, oklch(72% 0.15 75)); } .ds-nav-item--active { color: var(--color-ink, oklch(24% 0.014 75)); } .ds-nav-item--active .ds-nav-icon { color: var(--color-signal, oklch(72% 0.15 75)); } .ds-nav-icon { width: 1.125rem; height: 1.125rem; flex-shrink: 0; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-nav-item { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview:
A clean, brightly lit surface where every tool sits exactly where the hand reaches for it. The interface behaves like a well-organized parts counter: the operator is mid-transaction with a customer waiting, a scanner in one hand, and needs the right part number and price to surface in a fraction of a second. Nothing decorative competes for that attention. The screen is calm, high contrast, and dense where density buys speed.

The system commits to one signal color, a warm amber, and otherwise stays in near-neutral tones tinted slightly warm so the surface never reads as clinical gray. Amber is the single light on the workbench: it marks the one action that matters, the current selection, and where focus lives. Its scarcity is what makes it readable at a glance. Everything else is structure and type. A single quiet green ("brand") appears only in the "keep" wordmark — identity, never an interactive signal, so amber's exclusivity as the one actionable color holds.

This system explicitly rejects the clunky legacy ERP look (gray-on-gray, cramped 2010-era forms), the generic SaaS template (purple gradients, identical card grids, hero-metric dashboards), anything that reads as a toy or consumer app, and over-animated or flashy motion that would slow a high-volume counter. It is closer to a well-built terminal or Linear than to a marketing site. The implementation confirms the seed direction and adds one real refinement: even elevation stays warm — floating shadows are tinted with Ink, not generic black.
keyCharacteristics: Light, high-contrast surface tuned for bright retail-counter lighting.
One amber signal accent, on under 10% of any screen.
Warm-tinted neutrals, never pure #fff or #000 — including shadows.
System sans with tabular numerals for prices, quantities, and SKUs.
Dense but legible; hierarchy stays obvious. Display scale is reserved for the one number that matters: the sale total.
Two responsive tiers only (sm 640px, lg 1024px): stacked forms below sm, two-pane list/detail and the persistent sidebar from lg up.
Responsive, state-only motion; no choreography. prefers-reduced-motion is honored everywhere.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Amber appears on at most one primary thing per view: the action that completes the task, the row that is selected, or the field that has focus. If two amber things compete on a screen, one is wrong.

rules.name: The No Pure Extremes Rule
rules.body: Never #fff, never #000. Every neutral is tinted toward the amber hue (chroma 0.006 to 0.014). A pure-gray surface reads as legacy ERP.

rules.name: The Tinted Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are colored with Ink, not a generic black (shadow-ink/5, shadow-xl on the warm Counter surface). Elevation stays warm even when it lifts off the page.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: Every number that represents money, quantity, or an identifier uses tabular figures. Columns of prices and counts must align to the digit. Proportional digits in a price column are a defect.

rules.name: The One Display Rule
rules.body: Display scale (1.875rem/600) is reserved for the single most important number on a screen — today, only the POS total. A second Display-scale element on the same screen is a defect, not emphasis.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Separation comes from tonal neutral layers and hairline borders. A shadow only appears on something that genuinely floats above the page — a popover, a dialog, a fixed hint — never as decoration on a resting card or table row.

dos: Do keep Signal Amber on under 10% of any screen, the primary action, current selection, and focus only. Its scarcity is the point.
Do tint every neutral toward the amber hue; use a warm off-white surface and a warm near-black ink — including shadows (Ink-tinted, never generic black).
Do enforce tabular numerals on every price, quantity, and SKU.
Do make every core action fully operable by keyboard and scanner, with a visible focus ring at all times and predictable focus so scanned input never lands in the wrong field.
Do keep motion responsive and state-only (150–300ms), and respect prefers-reduced-motion on every transition, skeleton, and progress fill.
Do stay flat by default; separate surfaces with tonal neutral layers and hairline borders; reserve shadows for things that genuinely float (dropdown, dialog, fixed hint).
Do reserve Display-scale type (1.875rem) for the one number that matters on a screen — don't promote ordinary headings to it.
donts: Don't ship the clunky legacy ERP look: no gray-on-gray, no cramped 2010-era forms, no pure-gray surfaces, no SAP/old-POS-terminal aesthetic.
Don't fall into the generic SaaS template: no purple gradients, no identical icon-heading-text card grids, no hero-metric dashboard, no AI-slop defaults.
Don't let it read as a toy or consumer app; this handles money and inventory and must stay businesslike.
Don't over-animate; no choreographed entrances, no decorative motion, no bounce or elastic easing. Motion that slows the counter is a defect.
Don't use #fff or #000 anywhere, including in shadows (no generic rgba(0,0,0,...)).
Don't use a colored side-stripe border (border-left/border-right over 1px) as an accent, gradient text, or decorative glassmorphism.
Don't use proportional digits in any column of prices or counts.
Don't reach for a full-page or table-wide spinner; use skeletons shaped like the content instead. A small inline spinner is only acceptable for a short, localized load already inside an open panel.
